deviation.discoveredAt: after all 16 scheduled sessions had completed
deviation.mechanism: the generation selection was sent as `{ handles: [ ... ] }`, but the host contract `KnowledgeSelectionRequest` is `{ proof?, reasoning?, procedure? }`; the unknown field was ignored, so no handle was compiled and no pull was possible
deviation.whySilent: the delegation accepted the request and the attempt reported `knowledgeSelected: true`, so every host-side signal said the selection had been made; only the CONSUMER-BOUNDARY payload showed zero compiled handles
deviation.workerSurface: the CAPITALIZED worker received exactly the RAW_HISTORY surface: no compiled handle, no capital index entry, no pullable capital handle
deviation.repair: the selection is now sent in the owner shape (`proof`/`reasoning`/`procedure`), each entry carrying the owner own reference fields
deviation.repairVerified: a real generation child driven with the corrected selection compiled 2 handles, delivered both to the consumer boundary, and resolved both through the governed pull (257 and 2136 body bytes)
deviation.harnessDigestDrift: scripts/r3l0c/capital.mjs changed after the plan recorded its digest, so the committed plan no longer matches the working tree

preservedRun.kind: preserved run after a protocol deviation
preservedRun.preservedBy: a PRESERVE marker in the run root, which the sweep routine honours as ACTIVE regardless of lease state
notUsableFor: the reconstruction-compression verdict, because the treatment was absent
the net cognitive-cost verdict, for the same reason
any claim about capital effectiveness or capital overhead
usableFor: the harness defect is real and was reachable in the scheduled configuration
the consumer-boundary witness catches a silent delivery failure that no host-side signal reports
the preflight, containment and validity gates all passed on the executed run
preservedRun.stopReason: a load-bearing harness defect was discovered after behavioral exposure, and §23 forbids a plan amendment afterwards
